title: Gift bookkeeping rewritten in bulk; activity icon list fix
summary: The gift table, the internal reward-bundle bookkeeping behind store purchases, mail and event payouts, was rewritten across ids 81983-100573: roughly 18,600 field changes plus four entries removed. It renders as aggregate counts only and names no reward a player would recognise, so read it as back-end bookkeeping. The one client-side change is a fix to the main-screen activity icon list.
highlights: gift.giftid: 16,983 rows increased and 114 decreased, so most entries now point at a different reward id.
These are aggregate counts only; the diff renders no per-entry detail for this table, so no individual reward can be named.
Main screen: an activity icon whose prefab is still loading is no longer re-parented immediately; the move is deferred to its load callback.
